trigger_condition: showView(name) called with a name absent from the `views` map (e.g. data-view typo)
potential_consequence: Every view element is hidden simultaneously; app shows a blank screen with no visible content

trigger_condition: User dismisses the update banner, then app relaunches with the same update still pending
potential_consequence: Identity-bar version badge keeps showing 'update available' even though the user already dismissed it; no way to clear the badge at all

trigger_condition: User clicks a sidebar item (agents/health/about/connect/home) while an install engine.run() or pty session is still active in wizard-view
guard_snippet: if (engineRunning) { if (!confirm('Installation in progress — leave anyway?')) return; }
potential_consequence: Sidebar silently navigates away from a running install; user loses visibility into the in-progress pty output without cancelling it

trigger_condition: CLI update becomes available — previously highlighted #installation-group and #update-cli-tile via classList/dataset
guard_snippet: Re-add the classList.add('update-available') / dataset.state='highlight' toggles in showUpdateBanner()/dismissUpdateBanner(), or delete the now-unreachable CSS rules
potential_consequence: Update-available visual highlight on the CLI tile is permanently lost; CSS rules for it become dead/unreachable code
